purpose: Evaluate whether GLM-5.2 changes the completed German and English hosted-model comparison before considering any broader multilingual run.

stages.decision: Complete one 24-target pass unless the response contract becomes unreachable, a token limit is reached, or an accepted output exceeds the 30 percent normalized word-edit boundary.
Repeat only if GLM-5.2 is competitive with Gemini 3.6 Flash overall or has a credible German- or English-specific advantage.

evaluation_policy.rationale: The raw transcript remains available and enhancement is optional. One repeat is sufficient to reject a candidate that trails the established control overall and in both target languages.

irreversible_early_stop.mechanical: Stop once accepted requests plus every remaining request in the active gate cannot reach its minimum.
irreversible_early_stop.token_limit: Stop after the first token-limit failure.
irreversible_early_stop.gross_edit: Stop after the first mechanically accepted target above the 30 percent normalized word-edit boundary.
irreversible_early_stop.correct_input_regression: Record and continue; inspect severity after the full repeat.

cost_policy.conservative_input_accounting: Count each rendered Unicode code point as one input token for the hard planning envelope; this deliberately overstates normal tokenizer usage.

decision_rule: Run repeat two only if GLM-5.2 passes the basic gates and is competitive with the frozen Gemini 3.6 Flash repetition-one control overall or in at least one target language. Expand to all five languages only after repeat stability establishes a credible advantage.
claim_limit: This selected synthetic German and English development challenge can reject a weak candidate quickly but cannot establish a multilingual product default.
